annotations.title: Assess a datasheet before extracting it

description: Judge whether a datasheet PDF is likely to extract well BEFORE you spend credits on it. Pass the public https URL of the PDF (datasheetvend_search_component_library returns one as datasheet_pdf_url). It reads up to 25 pages and checks structure deterministically: the text layer (scanned or image-only PDFs extract less reliably), page count, which standard datasheet sections are present (sectionsFound of sectionsChecked), and whether it is a family datasheet naming several packages. REPORT THE VERDICT AS GIVEN (likely_good, likely_partial, unlikely, unknown) and do not talk it up: hard gates only ever lower it. Read out the signals, and state the limitations: this is a structural assessment, never a promise that a module (pinout, thermal, footprint) will succeed. textTruncated and truncatedBy say when the read stopped early, so later sections were not seen. If the document cannot be fetched, say it could not be read; do not guess. Deterministic: no model, no extraction, nothing stored, costs no credits, needs a DatasheetVend API key.

document_url.description: The public https:// URL of the datasheet PDF (over stdio, a local path also works).
